_meta.basis: Consolidated from FY26 (Ather Energy Ltd plus small overseas subsidiaries); FY25 and earlier standalone (Screener marks them S). Volumes are company wholesale dispatches (India + Nepal/Sri Lanka). Every number carries src and published date; sources are listed in `sources`.

callPoints: First positive EBITDA quarter on the company's definition (incl. other income): Rs9.45 cr, 0.8% of total income; on Screener's basis (before other income) EBITDA was still -Rs33 cr (-2.7%).

Wholesale 83,173 (+81%), registrations 90,808 (+102%); paid pre-orders 1.5 lakh in the quarter (+158%); dealer stock down from 14 days to 3. Management thinks it could have sold 13-15k more scooters a month.

Hosur is capped at ~35,000 a month (4.2 lakh a year) and was ~100% utilised by August; AURIC (Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar) Phase 1 adds 5 lakh a year: trial production from the festive season, reliable output from January 2027, a 4-5 month ramp to 42,000 a month (end-Q4FY27 or early FY28).

Commodities: index +46% over five quarters; ~5.6pp hit to gross margin in Q1 (AGM 22.4% vs 25.4% exit-Q4). Another 1-2pp of risk, largely covered by price rises already taken (ASP ~Rs1.61 lakh from June vs ~Rs1.50 lakh in Q4).
Konarc (EL platform) to cannibalise Rizta more than the 450; lower ASP; AtherStack Pro attach guided at 75%+ on EL. Electric motorcycle 'two years plus' away.

Management said 15-20% of Q1 vehicles may have been sold without the PM E-DRIVE subsidy (reason not given); on the 3-Aug call the extension beyond 31-Jul-2026 was still awaited. The government extended the e-2W subsidy to Mar-2028 on 11-Aug-2026 at Rs2,500/kWh, capped at Rs5,000 a vehicle.

guidance.said: Revenue from the new factory before the end of FY27, most likely Q4.
guidance.outcome: Q1 call: trial output from festive, reliable from Jan-2027.

guidance.said: Short-term margin pressure; only partly passed on so far; hits to come in coming quarters.
No specific FY27 store guidance (700 ECs at Mar-26).
Total capacity ~75,000 a month by Q1FY28 'very high likelihood'; AURIC ramp 4-5 months to 42,000 a month.
Further 1-2pp commodity risk, largely offset by price rises already taken; Q2 should see no material RM degradation; AURIC fixed costs from Q4.
Planning stage; may be fast-tracked; firmer timelines in a quarter or two; Rs2,500 cr raise sized with it in mind.
SOP at Hosur in Q2FY27; up to 60,000 a month across Hosur and AURIC; AtherStack Pro attach 75%+.
guidance.outcome: Launched 29-Aug-2026 from Rs99,999; deliveries from mid-Sep in phases.

timeline.event: Founded in Bengaluru by Tarun Mehta and Swapnil Jain (IIT Madras).
Hero MotoCorp invests (first round 2016); Ather 450 launched (2018); Ather Grid fast-charging network started.
FAME-II subsidy cut (Jun-2023) and the off-board charger show-cause; Ather moves to AtherStack Pro software packs to rebuild margins.
Rizta family scooter launched: 2 lakh+ sold by Dec-2025; drives Middle and North India growth.
Board approves the AURIC factory (~100 acres, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar; 95-year lease, Rs95.5 cr upfront).
IPO at Rs321: fresh issue Rs2,626 cr + OFS Rs355 cr; listed.
EL scooter platform and Zenith motorcycle platform unveiled at Community Day.
QIP: 1.08 cr shares at Rs1,202 (Rs1,300 cr), 8x subscribed.
Preferential issue: 16.3 lakh shares at Rs1,230 to the India Japan Fund (NIIF) and 79.4 lakh warrants at Rs1,260 to Hero MotoCorp and the founders (Rs1,200 cr).
Konarc (EL platform) launched from Rs99,999 ex-showroom Bengaluru; six variants; deliveries from mid-Sep in phases.
